How a visit runs

  1. 08:00

    Punch in, walk the list

    We arrive on time, go through your items with you, and agree on the order before a tool comes out.

  2. 08:10–11:40

    Work it in that order

    One item at a time, checked off as it's done, so nothing slips between jobs.

  3. 11:55

    Walk-through, punch out

    We show you each fix, clean the work areas, and leave by noon.

    What fits in a visit

    One trip covers the whole list, so a single small job never carries a call-out on its own.

      Four hours from 8:00 to 12:00, with your list worked in the order we agree on.
